er.comment: Detection.md entry 10: `erDiagram`, exact. The lexer then reads the header again, case-insensitively and not followed by a word character. Follows er.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read trivia before a separator-led common comment. Follows common.md#comment-lines.
Rules 19 to 21: bounded class, subgraph and end are keywords, compared case-insensitively. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.
patterns.name: keyword.control.mermaid

patterns.comment: Decimal digit runs, optionally with a dot and nonempty fraction, are numbers after the cardinality rules have been tried. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.
patterns.name: variable.mermaid

patterns.comment: Names contain non-ASCII characters, word characters, hyphens, stars and dots. an entity continues a name without exposing its hash or semicolon. A directive ends a name run. Follows er.md#units-and-contexts.
An entity placeholder is part of a name. Follows er.md#units-and-contexts.

er-direction.comment: TB, BT, RL and LR are tried in this order, at the last direction for that value; surrounding runs are direction-text. Directives inside those runs join their parts and cannot supply direction or its value; directives between components are trivia. Runs stop before separator-led common comments, and padding never consumes their separator. Follows er.md#the-statement-context and common.md#comment-lines.

patterns.comment: Rule 8: a double quote, zero or more characters other than double quote, and a double quote make a string with no escape. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.

er-relationships.comment: The ordered cardinality rules precede numbers and names, and relationship lines follow the cardinalities. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.

patterns.comment: Symbol cardinalities, many(0), many(1), contextual 1, u before dot/hyphen/bar, and two-character relationship lines are relationship units. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.arrow.mermaid

patterns.comment: Bounded word cardinalities and to or optionally to are case-insensitive keywords, with one space between words. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.
patterns.match: (?i:one or zero|one or more|one or many|zero or one|zero or more|zero or many|only one|many|one|optionally to|to){{wordEnd}}
patterns.name: keyword.operator.arrow.mermaid

er-punctuation.comment: Rules 12 to 16: comma, class separator, colon and alias/title brackets are punctuation units. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.

patterns.comment: Rule 13: ::: is a unit. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.
patterns.name: punctuation.separator.class.mermaid

patterns.comment: Rule 14: colon is a unit. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.

patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read one unquoted relationship role. Follows er.md#relationships.
Rules 15 and 16: brackets delimit an alias or subgraph title. Follows er.md#entities.

patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read the unquoted alias or subgraph title as label text. Follows er.md#subgraphs.

er-style.comment: Rules 17 and 18 and bounded style and classDef enter a style context with no keyword rules; colon, comma, hash, semicolon and style-text are its units until a line feed. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.

patterns.comment: Read a style property name before its colon. Follows er.md#other-statements.

patterns.name: punctuation.separator.semicolon.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read the style statement separator. Follows er.md#the-style-context.
Read one whole style property value, leaving trailing whitespace outside its scope. Follows er.md#other-statements.
Read a whole style without a property colon as one value, leaving trailing whitespace outside it. Follows er.md#other-statements.

er-attributes.comment: { enters attributes and } leaves them; statement keywords are words here, while PK, FK and UK are key units. Tilde words precede quoted and backquoted words. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.

patterns.comment: Rule 1: one or more whitespace characters, line feeds included, are nothing and precede keys and words. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.
Rule 2: PK, FK and UK, compared case-insensitively and not followed by a word character, are keys. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.
patterns.name: storage.modifier.mermaid
comment.block.ignored.mermaid
patterns.comment: Retain an empty backquoted block item as ignored text. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.
Read an attribute type and then its optional modifier and name; the type's complete lexical form must fit on a physical line. Follows er.md#attributes.

patterns.name: variable.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read a complete tilde word in its attribute role. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.
Read backquoted attribute text in its type or name role. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.

patterns.name: variable.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read the ordinary attribute word in its type or name role. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.

patterns.name: storage.modifier.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read the optional type modifier. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.

patterns.name: entity.name.type.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read a complete tilde word in its attribute role. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.
Read backquoted attribute text in its type or name role. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.

patterns.name: entity.name.type.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read the ordinary attribute word in its type or name role. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.
Rule 8: question mark is the optional attribute mark. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.
patterns.name: storage.modifier.mermaid

er-backquote.comment: A backquote starts a unit whose text runs to the next matching delimiter, with no escape mechanism. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.

patterns.comment: Runs stop before separator-led common comments, and padding never consumes their separator. Follows er.md#the-attribute-block-context.
patterns.name: variable.mermaid

er-acc-descr-block.comment: Read the er-acc-descr-block form. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.

patterns.comment: Runs stop before separator-led common comments, and padding never consumes their separator. Follows er.md#accessibility-values and common.md#comment-lines.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

er-accessibility-line.comment: Accessibility line text runs to the line feed, including inline percent pairs. the value ends before a line or paragraph separator when only whitespace and directives lead to a common comment. Retain this local context: reads whitespace after the delimiter with that delimiter and keeps inline percent pairs; its keywords are case-insensitive. Follows er.md#accessibility-values.

er-comma.comment: Rule 12 and #the-attribute-block-context rule 8: a comma is a separator outside an attribute word. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.
er-comma.name: punctuation.separator.comma.mermaid

er-direction-text.comment: Read the nonblank ignored text around a direction while retaining directives. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.

patterns.name: comment.block.ignored.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read a nonblank direction-text unit. Follows er.md#the-statement-context.

comment: The local padding variables retain the whitespace required by this type's unit rules, stopping before separator-led comments. Text and context variables below name the corresponding rules of this diagram. Follows er.md#lexical-structure and common.md#comment-lines.
